scope: officer identity/appearance binding, normal save, common world clock, two-unit field fixture
accepted_visual_baseline: TrialV3 at 62c3875cbf3c459a7a0bcf18ee249725f8113a0c; user: とりあえずこれでいこうか
storage: optional Officers extension to tax-prototype-v5.json; null legacy saves receive deterministic defaults when opened by normal Main

rules.units: two tactical fixture sides, existing character-001/002; no political organization or allegiance changes
rules.authority: explicit actor/unit/jurisdiction/basis/[from,until) grant checked at dispatch and receipt
rules.orders: explicit per-unit Engage/Withdraw; positive delay; arrival before effect; same due-time contradictory actions rejected
rules.time: one battle step per common integer world tick; no separate battle clock
rules.same_tick: field order arrival, movement/contact or simultaneous damage from pre-damage values; existing tax event processing retains its own causal order
rules.casualties: soldier ledger only; does not imply commander death, capture, political defection or destruction
rules.exit: retain unit/survivors in saved state; hide field model only after boundary reached
rules.npc: both sides willingness is explicit fixture input; no omniscient NPC policy implemented
rules.receipt: arrival, authority, scripted fixture willingness, effective action are separate; record Accepted/Unauthorized/Refused/AlreadyStopped

presentation.pause: freeze common tick and fractional display phase, all motion and animation
presentation.movement: interpolate previous committed position to current position; no predicted damage
presentation.walk: cumulative distance / measured source rig stride; same across outfits
presentation.save: snapshot display fraction and speed together with world/appearance/battle; explicit restore
presentation.lod: mid in field fixture, retain TrialV3 far quality limitation rather than using it close

not_implemented: production command delivery failures for military orders
